notes: Profile studio: change your display name and picture, and it follows you into all three apps
A profile photo prompt generator with styles, moods and palettes, plus an offline avatar generator
Workspace shows your name and picture with a one-click Edit profile button
The nav avatar shows your name and picture as soon as the page settles, not after a click
A failed server call says the HYDRA server could not be reached instead of claiming there is no on-device account
One navigation bar on every page: ecosystem switch, search, add to device, fullscreen and your profile
The ecosystem button now lives in the navigation bar, not on the home page
Search finds apps, actions, tasks, notes and memories — press Ctrl+K or / to open it
Workspace has a real sign-in: email and password, create account, or continue as guest
Install all three apps at once, or one at a time, from Add to device
Fullscreen and profile-picture buttons sit in the navigation bar
